name: Member's Mark Roasted Salted Mixed Nuts (Cashews, Almonds, Pecans Warning)
whyItWorks: Whole roasted nuts have hard, sharp edges when broken down by teeth. In patients with active Crohn's, strictures, or previous bowel resections, nut particles frequently cause mechanical bowel obstructions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mechanical Obstruction Warning: Strictly avoid whole nuts. Switch to smooth creamy seedless nut butter in remission.
